decision: Remove the packed committed-token readback candidate. It reduces ready-data D2H API overhead but does not improve operation-complete C8 wall; retain bounded payload plus per-request accepted-token reads.

ownership_audit.required_host_payload: Per-request accepted count, commit row/token/position, next token, full-accept flag, and accepted token IDs are required to update public generated IDs and host scheduling state.
ownership_audit.control_d2h: One 8x7 int32 packed status payload (224 B) plus eight per-request accepted-token slices of at most four int32 values at C8/K3.
ownership_audit.candidate_d2h: One status payload plus one contiguous 8x32 int32 committed-output matrix (1024 B).
ownership_audit.telemetry_correction: mtp2_target_readback_ms is added to every request row, so the route-level sum is request-count multiplied. Most first-copy latency is the required producer dependency on target compute, not D2H transfer cost.

ready_data_micro.protocol: Pre-populated device buffers, 200 alternating host perf-counter pairs; control uses 1+8 D2H calls, candidate uses 1+1 D2H calls.

c8_marker.protocol: Dirty current-source cached-only rocprofv3 kernel+ROCTx, one train prompt, C8/K3/D12, sequential control then candidate.
c8_marker.verdict: Target wall is effectively flat and complete wall regresses; stop before full-suite spend.

validation.focused_contract: Default bounded-copy dependency test passed with no global synchronize.
validation.final_tree: No candidate branch, environment flag, or test remains.

limitations: Dirty marker rejection only; no retained performance claim.
